children: California Resources Corp. said it signed an agreement with an undisclosed buyer to divest its assets in the Uinta Basin, located mostly in Utah and Colorado, for about $90 million.

Chief Executive Francisco Leon on Thursday said that the sale will further align the company's portfolio with its California operations, as well as capture additional value from its merger with Berry, which was finalized late last year.
"This transaction enhances our capital allocation flexibility, allowing us to invest in higher-return opportunities within the Golden State and supports our shareholder return strategy," Leon said.
"The sale also helps offset the purchase price of our recent midstream transaction."
California Resources, an energy and carbon management company, said it plans to provide additional financial and operating guidance following the transaction's close, expected by year end.
